chunks: Ammar ibn al-Husayn (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Ismat narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Tabari in Mecca narrated to us, saying: Al-Husayn ibn al-Lays al-Razi narrated, from Shayban ibn Farukh al-Abali, from Hammam ibn Yahya, from al-Qasim ibn Abd al-Wahid, from Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Aqil, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah al-Ansari, who said:

One day I was with the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), when he turned his face towards Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) and said: 'Shall I give you glad tidings, O Abu al-Hasan?' He said: 'Yes, O Messenger of God.' He said: 'This is Gabriel informing me from God, may His Majesty be Exalted, that He has granted your followers and your lovers nine characteristics: Gentleness at the time of death, companionship at the time of loneliness, light at the time of darkness, security at the time of fear, justice at the time of the scales, passage across the Bridge, entering Paradise before other people, and their light running before them and on their right side.'
ai.seo_question: What are the nine characteristics granted to the followers of Ali by God?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* highlights the eschatological privileges of the *Shi'a* (followers) of Ali ibn Abi Talib, emphasizing their distinct status in the afterlife. The nine blessings—ranging from ease at death to early entry into Paradise—underscore the theological concept of divine favor (*tawassul*) granted through love for the Ahl al-Bayt, a core tenet in Shia scholarship. These characteristics serve as both spiritual assurances and indicators of the purity of faith associated with the Prophet's family.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 9-2 Abu Muhammad Am’mar ibn al-Hussein al-Asrooshani - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Ismat quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Tabary in Mecca, on the authorityof Al-Hassan ibn al-Lays al-Razi, on the authority of Shayban ibn Farookh al-Abali, on the authority of Homam ibn Yahya, on the authority of Al-Qasim ibn Abdul Vahid, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Aqil, on the authority of Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari, “One day I was with the Prophet (MGB).

Then suddenly he turned his face towards Ali ibn Abi Talib (MGB) and said, “O Father of Hassan! Do you want me to give you glad tidings?" (Imam) Ali (MGB) said, “Yes, O Prophet of God!” The Prophet (MGB) continued, “God - may His Majesty be Exalted - informed me through Gabriel that He granted nine things to your lovers and your followers. They will have:1- gentle treatment at the time of death,2- a companion at times of fear,3- light at times of darkness,4- security at the time of Resurrection,5- justice at the time of Reckoning,6- permission to pass through the passage (to Heaven),7- entry to Heaven before other people,8- with the light (of their faith) shining in front of them and9- on their right side.”
